title: Créer un prototype statique des différentes pages

subtasks.title: Scaffold Vite+React app, design system & routing shell
subtasks.goal: Stand up the Vite+React SPA with the shared layout, design tokens imported from Claude Design, and the client-side route table for all six pages.
subtasks.seam: Vite + React + TypeScript app. react-router-dom v6 with routes: / (home), /films, /series, /livres, /docs (medium filter pages — own routes per owner decision, reuse the home feed filtered by medium for now), /article/:id (article — placeholder route only; real article view is designed BEFORE subtask 03), /bilan-culturel, /archives, /a-propos, /me-suivre. Shared <Layout> = <Header/> (site nav) + <main><Outlet/></main> + <Footer/>. Design tokens as CSS custom properties in src/styles/tokens.css (colors, typography scale, spacing, breakpoints) extracted from the Claude Design 'Clap et chapitre - Hifi' export. Mobile-first responsive: breakpoints sm/md/lg. Shared mock types in src/mock/types.ts (e.g. Article { id, title, excerpt, cover, date, author, body }). Each page below renders as a placeholder route wired into this shell.

subtasks.title: Home / main page (page principale)
subtasks.goal: Build the responsive main landing page from the design, using mock data.
subtasks.seam: Route / renders <HomePage> inside <Layout>. Consumes shared tokens + Article mock type. Static mock content only, responsive per mobile design.

subtasks.title: Article page
subtasks.goal: Build the responsive single-article page from the design, using mock data.
subtasks.seam: Route /article/:id renders <ArticlePage> inside <Layout>. Consumes shared tokens + Article mock type. Static mock article, responsive.

subtasks.seam: Route /bilan-culturel renders <BilanCulturelPage> inside <Layout>. Consumes shared tokens. Static mock content, responsive.

subtasks.seam: Route /archives renders <ArchivesPage> inside <Layout>. Consumes shared tokens + Article mock type. Static mock list, responsive.
